name: sftabs
description: Add custom tabs to the Salesforce setup menu

scripts.build:chrome: npm run manifest:chrome && npm run build -- --filename=sftabs-chrome-{version}.zip
scripts.build:firefox: npm run manifest:firefox && npm run build -- --filename=sftabs-firefox-{version}.zip
scripts.test: node test/storage-migration.test.js && node test/profile-resolution.test.js && node test/tab-colors.test.js && node test/floating-placement.test.js && node test/page-capture.test.js && node test/tab-order.test.js && node test/tab-membership.test.js && node test/org-colors.test.js && node test/settings-hub.test.js && node test/content-scope.test.js

author: Chris Rouse
